Keep her exact face identity, age, tan complexion, long black hair, hair clips, amber eyes and original anime style. Frame ONLY head and shoulders with generous headroom. White school blouse fully buttoned up to the collar, shoulders completely covered. Neutral attentive expression, upright ordinary school-photo pose, same blurred classroom lighting. No glamour, romance, erotic expression, exposed chest, text, panels or watermark. This reference will be used for nonsexual facial expressions.
